annotations.title: Get the booking link for an empty leg flight

description: Return the SkyAccess booking page link for a specific empty leg flight, for handing to a customer so they can review and book it themselves. This is read-only: it does not create, hold, modify or cancel any booking, and no booking exists until the customer completes it on the page. It sends no customer details to SkyAccess and does not ask a specialist to make contact.

flightId.description: The SkyAccess empty leg flight id, as given in the `flightId` field of a flight listing

name: booking_handoff
title: Get the booking link for an empty leg flight
